title: append

gpu_support.notes: MATLAB documents GPU code generation, not interactive GPU-array execution, for append. RunMat rejects resident numeric handles before provider dispatch or gather because numeric values are not text inputs.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: s = append(arg1, ...) combines string arrays, character vectors, or cell arrays of character vectors elementwise. A string input selects string output; otherwise a cell input selects cellstr output; otherwise all-character-vector input produces a character vector.
behaviors: Inputs are string arrays, character vectors, or cell arrays of character vectors.

If any input is a string array, the output is a string array. Otherwise, if any input is a cell array, the output is a cell array of character vectors. If all inputs are character vectors, the output is a character vector.
String arrays and cell arrays use compatible-size implicit expansion; a character vector is compatible with every other input size.
Trailing whitespace in every supported text representation is preserved.
Numeric, logical, and integer inputs reject rather than undergoing implicit text conversion. This includes all eight integer classes in scalar and array form.
Resident numeric handles reject before provider dispatch or gather; append has no interactive GPU-array or integer-output surface.
examples: append('Hello ', 'World') returns the character vector 'Hello World' and preserves the space.
